key.name: sheets
key.description: The text panels to draw, up to 4 per monitor. Each entry has monitor (connector name such as DP-1), path (empty for the built-in welcome text), name (empty to use the file name), font_family, font_size (points), x and y (pixels from the monitor's top-left corner), opacity (percent), padding (pixels), scale_x and scale_y (percent of the text's natural size) and lock_ratio (boolean). Empty shows the built-in text on the left-most monitor. The limits are applied in sheets.js.
